title: Run 24: large-scale encyclopedia traversal
hypothesis: Run 21 inferred corpus-wide saturation from only 6 concepts. Run 24 tests it EMPIRICALLY on a stratified sample of 48 encyclopedia concepts (target >=40) with REAL per-atom web search (R5). Saturation is corpus-wide ONLY if the large sample actually shows it; any domain/tier that escapes is a real lead (R12).

method.concept_sample: 48 concepts, 8 batches x 6, stratified by domain + maturity tier_prior, all OUTSIDE candidate_pool.md exhausted list. 3 positive controls (annealing, nucleation, diffusion) included for calibration.
per_concept_pipeline: 1. REAL WebSearch 'wikipedia <concept>' -> raw results recorded verbatim (R9)
2. Decompose Wikipedia mechanism into 2-3 mechanism atoms (verbatim quote >=30 chars, operator type) (R5 Belinda-strict)

3. REAL WebSearch each atom + ('machine learning' OR 'LLM' OR 'neural network') -> raw paper-hit count + ML-penetration, distinguishing ML-MEASURES-concept vs concept-mechanism-IMPORTED-as-architecture
4. Tag empirical maturity tier from paper-hit count
5. For sparsest atom, formulate ONE candidate LLM/AI niche
merge_verify: MERGE: collect candidates, rank by collision sparsity, form niche claims
VERIFY: 5 reformulations/candidate, REAL WebSearch each, collision check (Gate 3 >=5 distinct sources unanimous)
AUDIT: grounded-gap (Run 20) fresh held-out FUNCTIONAL search so no-collision is not a phrasing artifact

gates.gate_3: >=5 distinct verification searches, unanimous on the core claim
gates.gate_4: Belinda-strict: mechanism verb present, operator != ANALOGY_TRANSFERS_TO_OPEN, verbatim quote >=30 chars

hard_rules_honored.R3: Any Opus subprocess runs in non-git tempdir (no hook in container per R8)
hard_rules_honored.R5: Record ONLY search results actually seen; never fabricate. This is the whole point.
hard_rules_honored.R8: No pre_tool.py hook active in container; gates applied manually.
hard_rules_honored.R10: Full per-concept table + distribution stats reported.
hard_rules_honored.R12: No early-stop-by-inference. Conclude corpus-wide saturation only if the 48-sample shows it.

deviation_note: R1/R2 require each batch to commit+push. 8 agents pushing concurrently to one branch would race and fail (which R2 treats as STOP). Engineering resolution: agents WRITE batch files + return RAW search evidence; main context inspects then commits+pushes each WAVE immediately (cloud-wipe-safe, R1/R2 intent preserved). Documented honestly per the project's HONEST DEVIATION POLICY precedent.

result.prima_facie_no_collision: 45/48 (93.8%) -> collapses to 0/12 survivors under grounded-gap verification
result.headline: Saturation is corpus-wide and EMPIRICAL across 48 stratified concepts (vs Run 21's inference from 6). No domain/tier escaped. One honestly-reported trivial residual.
